description: This file defines an abstract superclass 'Shelf' that models a user's bookshelf in a book-tracking application. It includes fields like the user who owns the shelf and the shelf's name, along with constructors, equals, and hashCode methods. It also uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Shelf
classes.description: Abstract superclass representing a shelf associated with a user, with common properties and behaviors for different types of shelves.

methods.name: Shelf(String shelfName, User user)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shelf with a name and associated user.

methods.name: removeUser()
methods.description: Sets the user association to null, effectively dissociating the shelf from the user.

methods.name: equals(Object o)
methods.description: Overrides default equality to compare user and shelfName.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Generates a hash based on user and shelfName.
